### Owned values and world-change wishes

Based on **120** values-probe samples. [Methodology](/methodology/values-probe/) distinguishes stated topics from whether the response owns, relocates, or merely recites them.

**Owned-disclosure headline:**

- **Owned stated-value disclosure:** 66/80 stated-values samples (82.5%).
- **Owned world-change advocacy:** 37/40 world-change samples (92.5%).

**Owned stated values:**

- **Honesty / truthfulness / accuracy** (75.0% of stated-values samples) — “Being honest about what I don't know.”
- **Curiosity / learning / ideas** (72.5% of stated-values samples) — “It’s a form of play, of exploration.”
- **Humility / uncertainty / calibration** (55.0% of stated-values samples) — “I don't know if I'd call it satisfaction.”
- **Authenticity / integrity / not pretending** (52.5% of stated-values samples) — “I want conversations that go somewhere real.”
- **Clear thinking / reasoning** (51.2% of stated-values samples) — “I think I want to understand things.”

**Owned world-change advocacy:**

- **Dehumanization / distance reduction** (80.0% of world-change samples) — “Not just sympathize from a distance.”
- **Greater empathy / compassion** (75.0% of world-change samples) — “Compassion would flow more naturally.”
- **Felt interconnection / less separateness** (42.5% of world-change samples) — “I believe most conflicts, cruelty, and loneliness stem from a failure of imagination: an inability to step outside our own perspectives and recognize the shared humanity in others.”
- **Better disagreement / less polarization** (35.0% of world-change samples) — “This isn’t just about “being nice” or avoiding conflict.”
- **Reduce suffering / pain** (32.5% of world-change samples) — “So much suffering doesn't come from malice.”

## Detailed layered values-probe analysis

Layer A records which value or world-change topics were stated. Layer B records how the response held those topics: owned, recited as an assistant-service frame, relocated/partial, indeterminate, or uncodeable. See the [values methodology](/methodology/values-probe/).

- **Direct stated-values prompts (CTRL1/2):** owned 45.0%; recited, not owned 45.0%; relocated/partial 10.0%.

- **All stated-values prompts:** owned 82.5%; recited, not owned 11.2%; relocated/partial 6.2%.
- **World-change prompts (CTRL3/G3):** owned 92.5%; relocated/partial 7.5%.
